papers.title_en: OmniInteract: Towards Unified Whole-Body Interaction Control for Dual Humanoids
papers.authors: Yinghao Li, Tianyu Zhang, Zhuohao Li, Yi-Lin Wei, Fa-Ting Hong, Qing Zhang, Wei-Shi Zheng
papers.evidence: 通过残差策略学习实现双人形机器人统一全身交互运动控制
papers.tldr: 双人形机器人交互需全身协同与精确接触，但人机形态差异会破坏重定向接触界面，联合学习技能与协作又难以在技能增多时保持控制保真。OmniInteract 用表面接触感知重定向保留双人形接触界面与近场几何，并以可扩展流式交互策略生成伙伴条件残差动作。实验显示其提升重定向保真与双人形协调，技能多样化下仍较好保留交互性能。真机验证了接触建立、稳定全身协调及外部扰动恢复。
papers.abstract_en: Physical interaction is a key capability for humanoid collaboration, requiring coordinated whole-body motion and precise contact. However, learning diverse dual-humanoid interactions faces two major challenges: (1) human-robot morphological differences disrupt contact interfaces and spatial relationships during retargeting, and (2) jointly learning motor skills and partner coordination makes it difficult to retain control fidelity as interaction diversity grows. In this paper, we propose OmniInteract to address these challenges through surface-aware modeling and scalable residual policy learning. First, we introduce Surface Contact-Aware Retargeting, which leverages dense human-robot surface correspondences to jointly retarget both humanoids, preserving explicit interaction contact interfaces and their near-field geometric context. Second, we propose a Scalable Flow-based Interaction Policy for partner-conditioned residual generation. It factorizes dual-humanoid control into a reusable motor foundation and interaction-specific adaptations: partner-aware experts learn corrections over a frozen whole-body motion prior, while conditional flow matching unifies them in a shared residual action space. This enables scalable skill consolidation while retaining pretrained motor capabilities. Extensive experiments demonstrate that OmniInteract improves retargeting fidelity and dual-humanoid coordination while better retaining interaction performance as skill diversity grows. Real-world deployment further demonstrates successful contact establishment, stable whole-body coordination, and recovery from external perturbations.

papers.title_en: A Koopman--Polynomial Chaos Framework for SMPC of Nonlinear Stochastic Processes
papers.authors: Wallace Gian Yion Tan, Efstathios Iliakis, Liang Wu, Jan Drgona, Richard D. Braatz
papers.evidence: 以多项式混沌参数化Koopman算子的非线性随机控制
papers.tldr: 针对含参数不确定性与时变随机扰动的非线性系统随机模型预测控制问题，提出多项式参数化 Koopman 算子（PPKO）框架，用多项式混沌展开对 Koopman 算子进行参数化，将数据驱动动力学与不确定性传播统一起来。进一步推导出紧凑的确定性 SMPC 重构，可同时处理时不变参数不确定性与时变扰动，并使在线优化维度仅取决于控制时域和输入维度。Duffing 振子与电热冷却系统的算例验证了该框架的精度、可扩展性和闭环性能。
papers.abstract_en: This paper develops a polynomial parametric Koopman operator (PPKO) framework for stochastic model predictive control (SMPC) of nonlinear systems with parametric uncertainty and time-varying stochastic disturbances. The Koopman operator is parameterized by polynomial chaos expansions (PCEs), enabling data-driven nonlinear dynamics to be integrated with PCE-based uncertainty propagation and control. We show that the polynomial parameterization introduces no irreducible approximation gap beyond PCE truncation. We then derive a condensed deterministic SMPC reformulation that handles both time-invariant parametric uncertainty and time-varying disturbances while retaining an online optimization dimension that depends only on the control horizon and input dimension, independent of the lifted-state and PCE dimensions. The resulting formulation yields convex programs with expectation and second-moment constraints that can be solved using standard optimization methods. Numerical studies on the Duffing oscillator and the electrothermal cooling system demonstrate the accuracy, scalability, and closed-loop performance of the proposed framework.

papers.title_en: Dynamic self-ensemble on multi-exit residual vision transformer for small-data image classification
papers.authors: Stephen Ekaputra Limantoro, Yan-Kai Wang, Ching-Chun Huang, Hong-Han Shuai, Wen-Huang Cheng, Jungwoo Huh, Sanghoon Lee
papers.evidence: 面向小数据图像分类的多阶段残差ViT
papers.tldr: 视觉Transformer（ViT）在图像分类中表现突出，但其性能高度依赖大规模训练数据，在医学影像等小数据场景中应用受限。本文提出多阶段残差ViT模型ReSEViT，引入自集成学习与动态学习器选择（DLS），自适应融合各阶段分类器，并结合残差token嵌入增强局部结构建模。该方法旨在降低特征冗余、预测误差与方差，同时保持模型尺寸高效，为小数据图像分类提供有效方案。
papers.abstract_en: Vision Transformer (ViT) has garnered increased attention for image classification in recent years. However, ViT is notorious for its data-hungry problem as it achieves high-performance results when only trained on large-size datasets. In this paper, we study how ViT specifically works on small-scale datasets with limited data where the availability of image data is often constrained in practice, especially in fields such as medical imaging. To mitigate the issue, we designed a multi-stage residual ViT, dubbed ReSEViT, with the self-ensemble method to utilize multi-level information from intermediate features. Due to the complex decision boundaries for classifications, relying on a single classifier can lead to prediction errors. Hence, we propose a new learning method for ViT, named self-ensemble learning, which ensembles multi-stage classifiers in a single model. Our self-ensemble comprises a novel approach, Dynamic Learner Selection (DLS), to adaptively select the importance of different stages. ReSEViT incorporates residual token embeddings which is a ResNet-like block to model effective local structures alongside with transformer blocks in each stage. The integration of residual tokens and self-ensemble learning into a multi-stage ViT highlights the reduction in redundancy, prediction error and variance while maintaining an efficient model size for small-scale image datasets.

papers.title_en: Sample-Efficient Reinforcement Learning with General Utilities via Neural Dual Critics
papers.authors: Ankur Naskar, Vaneet Aggarwal
papers.evidence: 面向一般效用强化学习的神经对偶评论家自然演员评论家方法
papers.tldr: 针对一般效用强化学习需优化占用测度非线性泛函的问题，提出自然actor-critic方法，利用精确变分对偶表示，并直接以神经critic学习策略梯度伪奖励。critic采用投影随机更新，结合多级Monte Carlo跨训练时域控制偏差。理论证明在策略迁移、对偶稳定和局部critic正则条件下取得O~(T^{-1/2})全局收敛，采样复杂度为O~(ε^{-2})。该方法避免先估计占用测度，可覆盖无限状态-动作空间和更一般的占用效用。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with general utilities optimizes nonlinear functionals of policy-induced occupancy measures. We develop a natural actor-critic method for concave RLGU objectives admitting an exact variational dual representation, with explicit constructions for a broad class of separable occupancy utilities. Rather than estimating the occupancy measure and then forming the policy-gradient pseudo-reward, our method learns this pseudo-reward directly as a function of the state-action pair using a neural critic. The critic is trained by projected stochastic updates, while multilevel Monte Carlo combines outputs across training horizons to control its bias at logarithmic expected cost. Our analysis separates conditional actor bias from estimator second moments and accounts explicitly for dual optimization, critic approximation, and neural linearization errors. Under policy-transfer, dual-stability, and local critic-regularity conditions, the method achieves $\widetilde{O}(T^{-1/2})$ global convergence above policy, critic-class, and finite-width approximation errors using $\widetilde{O}(T)$ expected environment transitions and reference samples. For a fixed critic representation, this yields $\widetilde{O}(ε^{-2})$ sampling complexity above the approximation floor, covering infinite state-action spaces and occupancy utilities beyond fixed finite vectors of returns.

papers.title_en: MOSAIC: Multi-Objective Search for Allocating Inference Cache Across LLM Decoder Layers
papers.authors: Sravanth Kodavanti, Manjunath Arveti
papers.evidence: 面向逐层缓存预算分配的多目标神经架构搜索
papers.tldr: 长上下文 LLM 推理的 KV cache 内存瓶颈突出，但 SnapKV、H2O 等驱逐方法对各解码层使用相同预算。MOSAIC 将逐层 KV cache 预算分配建模为多目标神经架构搜索，一次搜索即可把最优分配迁移到不同目标预算。在 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 和 Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 上，它在 154 个设置中 146 个优于均匀分配，RULER 最高 +48 分、LongBench LCC +11.9 分。它还能以最多减少 4 倍缓存达到均匀分配分数，显示层间差异化缓存分配的价值。
papers.abstract_en: The Key-Value (KV) cache is the main memory bottleneck of long-context LLM inference. Token eviction methods such as SnapKV, H2O, AdaKV and L2Norm shrink it, but they give every transformer layer the same budget, although layers differ in which tokens they need. We present MOSAIC, a multi-objective neural architecture search that learns per-layer KV-cache budgets for any eviction method. One search maps the trade-off between average budget and task score; its best allocation transfers to every target budget without further search, and an optional budget-constrained search refines it. Across four eviction methods on Llama-3-8B-Instruct and Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2, MOSAIC beats uniform allocation in 146 of 154 (task, method, budget) settings, by up to +48 points on RULER and +11.9 on LongBench (LCC). On both models, it reaches the score of uniform allocation with up to 4x less KV cache (75% smaller). Against EvolKV, MOSAIC explores a ~10^40 x larger search space with 4x fewer evaluations and 18% fewer GPU-hours per budget, and scores higher in 5 of 6 settings. The learned allocations consistently favour a small set of middle layers.

papers.title_en: LOCU: Lowdin-Orthogonalized Constraint Updates for Multi-Constraint Policy Optimization
papers.authors: Joonyoung Lim, Younghwan Yoo
papers.evidence: CMDP中正交化约束更新的多约束策略优化
papers.tldr: 多约束策略优化中，约束梯度相互耦合易导致病态更新、数值脆弱及修正抵消或冗余。LOCU在Fisher-Rao度量下对奖励与约束的自然梯度做对称Löwdin正交化，并结合筛选与近共线压缩构建低维约简空间。该空间内信赖域化为欧氏球，约束通过低维主动集对称求解；不可行时构造保持已满足约束局部可行性的Pareto下降方向。实验显示其在高耦合、窄可行域和不可行起点下稳定，并可跨成本评论家架构泛化。
papers.abstract_en: We investigate multi-constraint policy optimization in constrained Markov decision processes (CMDPs), where interactions among constraint gradients often yield ill-conditioned update directions, causing numerically fragile steps and unintended cancellation or redundant overlap in constraint corrections. To address this, we propose LOCU, which mitigates numerical instability arising from constraint interactions by applying symmetric Lowdin orthogonalization to the natural gradients of the reward and constraints under the Fisher-Rao metric. Combined with Fisher-geometric screening and near-collinear compression, LOCU yields a compact reduced space in which the trust region becomes a Euclidean ball and constraints are handled symmetrically through a low-dimensional active-set solve. For infeasible iterates, LOCU constructs a Pareto-descent direction which preserves the local feasibility of satisfied constraints within the same reduced formulation. Experiments show that LOCU remains stable under high constraint coupling, narrow feasible regions, and infeasible starts, and generalizes across different cost critic architectures.

papers.title_en: HAF-VLA: Hierarchical Action Flow Framework for Humanoid Vision-Language-Action Control
papers.authors: Langzhe Gu, Chengkai Hou, Meng Li, Xinhua Wang, Xinyuan Lv, Shuanghao Bai, Guangrun Li, Jingyang He, Ziluo Ding, Zhiyuan Xu, Ning Ding, Kuan Cheng, Jian Tang, Shanghang Zhang, Zhengping Che
papers.evidence: 人形机器人全身视觉-语言-动作运动控制
papers.tldr: 人形机器人全身 loco-manipulation 动作空间维度高，基座与腰部微小误差会引发上身剧烈补偿，通用 VLA 难以直接落地。HAF-VLA 基于预训练 flow-matching VLA，继承视觉语言前缀编码器与动作专家权重，引入可学习阶段嵌入与跨阶段 KV-cache 条件，将全身动作分阶段渐进去噪：先移动与头部，再腰部细化，最后全身操作。六个真实任务上显著提升现有模型表现，为人形全身控制提供有效迁移路径。
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid robots hold great promise as general-purpose agents in human-centered environments, yet adapting generalist vision-language-action (VLA) policies to real-world humanoid loco-manipulation remains challenging. Unlike fixed-base or wheeled manipulators, humanoids must coordinate locomotion, posture, gaze, and dual-arm manipulation over a high-dimensional whole-body action space, where inaccurate base or waist motions can easily induce unstable and aggressive upper-body compensation. We propose HAF-VLA, a hierarchical action-flow framework for humanoid VLA control. Built upon a pretrained flow-matching VLA, HAF-VLA inherits the vision-language prefix encoder and action expert weights, and adapts them to humanoid whole-body loco-manipulation with learnable stage embeddings and cross-stage KV-cache conditioning. Instead of generating the full action chunk in a single pass, HAF-VLA progressively denoises a shared whole-body action space: first locomotion and head commands, then waist refinement, and finally full-body manipulation. To preserve structural dependencies across stages, we introduce a cross-stage KV cache conditioning mechanism, enabling subsequent action generation stages to refine and augment their outputs based on the action representations from preceding stages. Experimental results across six real-world tasks demonstrate that our framework significantly enhances the performance of existing models in humanoid loco-manipulation tasks, demonstrating an effective pathway for adapting strong mobile-manipulation VLAs to humanoid whole-body loco-manipulation.

papers.title_en: First Passage Attention
papers.authors: Yuxuan Liu
papers.evidence: 提出新的注意力结构变体以改进长上下文建模
papers.tldr: 现有带遗忘门的 softmax 注意力依赖键-查询路径上的衰减累加，单调性使其无法在保留较早结构相关 token 的同时选择性擦除中间上下文。本文提出 First Passage Attention（FPA），将路径求和改为路径极值：依据学习标量场在区间内的最深下探幅度按比例降低键的 logit，并把 FoX 纳入特例。合成任务中单层 FPA 头可收敛到目标保留键集合，基线在所有随机种子失败；110M 语言模型上困惑度追平 FoX，并在 8 倍训练长度下实现完美 passkey 检索，KV 缓存压缩至约 25%。
papers.abstract_en: Augmenting softmax attention with forget gates typically relies on summing decay contributions along the key--query path. Because such accumulation is monotonic, these mechanisms cannot selectively erase intermediate context while preserving older, structurally relevant tokens. We propose First Passage Attention (FPA), which shifts from path summation to path extrema by lowering a key's logit proportionally to the deepest dip of a learned scalar field below that key's level over the intervening span. FPA encompasses the Forgetting Transformer (FoX) as a special case, and when the field and levels follow a shared learned walk, the alive keys with unpenalised logits naturally form a stack. We show that a constant-dimension FPA head realises any subset of keys left alive by subsequent dips, whereas softmax heads with positional biases or token-level forget gates require a head dimension linear in the number of keys. In synthetic experiments, one-layer FPA heads converge to these target sets while comparable softmax and FoX baselines fail on every seed. Scaling to a 110M-parameter language model, FPA matches FoX in perplexity and uniquely achieves perfect passkey retrieval at $8\times$ the training length, even with its key--value cache compressed to about $25\%$.

papers.title_en: Action-Aligned Latent Planning for Versatile Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.authors: Yutang Lin, Guanya Shi, C. Karen Liu
papers.evidence: 人形机器人全身运动操作与潜在规划
papers.tldr: 面向多样人形移动操作，单一感知策略需兼顾高层任务决策与全身控制响应。FIBER以冻结行为基础模型的可行潜空间为共享规划表示，通过潜策略投影将各技能策略对齐到该空间，并离线训练单一感知流规划器。仿真三任务128种变化下平均成功率42.0%，显著超过潜回放11.6%与运动学规划3.5%。真机Unitree G1验证了迁移、技能串联与条件转向。
papers.abstract_en: Learning a single perceptive policy for diverse humanoid loco-manipulation requires unifying high-level task decisions without losing the state-dependent physical responses that make each interaction succeed. This makes the representation between high-level planning and whole-body control critical: kinematic or contact targets provide compact abstractions but do not directly encode interaction-specific control responses, while directly predicting low-level actions requires the planner to model high-frequency closed-loop feedback. We propose FIBER, a framework that uses the executable latent space of a frozen behavioral foundation model (BFM) as a shared planning representation for heterogeneous interaction skills. Our latent policy projection (LPP) maps independently acquired task-specific policies into this representation by identifying latent commands whose induced actions match their local control responses, enabling lower-rate planning while retaining the BFM's high-frequency state feedback. After projection, we aggregate closed-loop latent rollouts from all skills and train a single perceptive flow planner entirely offline. We further introduce AH-BFM, an adaptive-horizon BFM trained with multi-gamma forward-backward (FB) learning to support both precise control and temporally extended whole-body behavior. We evaluate FIBER on box pickup, door opening, and object grasping in simulation and on a real Unitree G1 humanoid. Across 128 diverse variations per task in simulation, FIBER achieves 42.0% mean success, more than tripling projected latent replay (11.6%) and substantially outperforming kinematic planning (3.5%). Real-world experiments further demonstrate sim-to-real transfer, skill chaining, and conditional steering through the same unified planner.

papers.title_en: DiPLO: Self-distilled Diffusion Planning for Loco-manipulation
papers.authors: Shafeef Omar, Sebastian Sanokowski, Elham Daneshmand, Dian Yu, Daniel Cremers, Cordelia Schmid, Majid Khadiv
papers.evidence: 自蒸馏扩散规划器结合强化学习全身跟踪的人形移动操作
papers.tldr: DPO去除强任务条件依赖，并以DA:PPO微调对齐冻结跟踪器。在取-搬-放任务上成功率达99%，预训练模型仅45%，并泛化到未见物体目标及踢、推拉任务。最终在Unitree G1实机重复执行成功，无需真实世界微调。
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid loco-manipulation is particularly challenging because it requires coordinating locomotion, balance, and object interaction, making it difficult to learn from limited demonstrations or from scratch through Reinforcement Learning (RL). We introduce DiPLO (self-distilled Diffusion Planning for Loco-manipulation), a framework that combines a self-distilled diffusion planner with a low-level whole-body tracking policy. Our planner is pretrained via supervised learning on motions derived from human-to-humanoid retargeting, while the tracker is trained via RL to execute them. DiPLO centers around two complementary post-training stages. First, we introduce Self-Distillation Diffusion Policy Optimisation (SD:DPO) to remove the planner's dependence on strong task conditioning, which we identify as a crucial ingredient for effective pretraining, as downstream fine-tuning does not recover comparable performance when it is omitted.. We then fine-tune this distilled model with Diffusion-Augmented Proximal Policy Optimization (DA:PPO), a maximum-entropy RL method for diffusion models, to improve task success and align generated plans with the frozen tracker's execution capabilities. Together, these stages enable motion generation through state-history and goal conditioning alone, enabling 99% task success in pick-carry-place tasks, compared to just 45% for the pretrained model. The resulting planner also generates motions for unseen object goals, with further evaluations on kicking and pushing/pulling tasks. Finally, we deploy our pipeline on the hardware, using our DA:PPO planner-tracker on a Unitree G1, achieving repeated successful executions without any real-world fine-tuning.

papers.title_en: Humanoid SRL: Augmenting Humanoids with Supernumerary Limbs for Coordinated Loco-Manipulation
papers.authors: Fukang Liu, Feiyang Wu, Paul Barsa, Jaehwi Jang, Akshat Jain, Zhigen Zhao, Yipu Chen, Zhaoyuan Gu, Nikhil Vemuri, Anshul Chandaliya, Kaijie Zhu, Sean Lublinsky, Matthew Zhu, Tony G. Chen, Ye Zhao
papers.evidence: 人形机器人全身移动操作与平衡控制
papers.tldr: 人形机器人双臂被占用或需额外支撑时，原生形态会限制全身移动操作。研究将超数机械臂集成到人形平台，用基于模型的轨迹优化生成动态可行运动，并训练目标条件强化学习控制器零样本迁移到硬件。实验表明三臂能协调操作与支撑，扩展接触丰富的全身作业空间，并实现视觉引导自主执行。其意义在于把形态增强视为人形机器人可扩展的设计空间。
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid robots are envisioned to perform diverse human-level tasks through their anthropomorphic morphology. Their dual-arm configuration enables a broad range of everyday actions. Yet, as in humans, this morphology can constrain loco-manipulation when both arms are occupied or additional contacts are required beyond their reach. Supernumerary robotic limbs (SRLs) offer a way to extend these capabilities, but their integration requires the added limb to be coordinated with whole-body motion and balance. In this study, we develop and integrate a supernumerary arm into a humanoid platform to investigate how morphological augmentation reshapes its feasible action space. Through quantitative analysis and hardware experiments across two configurations, we show how the additional limb expands whole-body interaction capabilities by enabling manipulation and support to be coordinated beyond the constraints of the native dual-arm configuration. To control this augmented morphology, we leverage model-based trajectory optimization (TO) to generate dynamically feasible motions for goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (RL) controllers. The controllers are trained in simulation and transferred to hardware in a zero-shot manner, enabling coordinated whole-body skills for contact-rich tri-arm loco-manipulation. We further show vision-guided autonomous execution on selected tasks using diffusion policies trained from hardware demonstrations. Our findings suggest that humanoid morphology need not be restricted to human-like forms, but can be reimagined as an extensible design space for robotic augmentation.

papers.title_en: Validation of Human Motor Development Scales with Humanoid Robots
papers.authors: Fanxing Meng, Jing Xiao
papers.evidence: 用强化学习框架引导人形机器人逐步习得直至行走的运动技能
papers.tldr: 研究用婴儿运动发育量表指导人形机器人学习粗大运动技能，以检验量表能否作为独立训练指南。作者将各量表转成发育图，并嵌入强化学习框架，让机器人按自然阶段逐步掌握站立与行走。实验显示四种常用儿科量表中三种可成功引导技能发展，第四种因缺少中间里程碑而失败，补上后也成功。结果表明发育量表可转化为机器人学习课程，并暴露其完整性差异。
papers.abstract_en: We investigate how humanoid robots can learn a series of motor skills defined by human infant motor development scales, and we evaluate which scales are comprehensive enough to serve as self-contained guides for developing gross motor skills up to standing and walking. We represent each motor development scale as a developmental graph that guides the training of a humanoid robot. We then apply this graph within a reinforcement learning framework so that the robot learns skills following the natural phases of human motor development described by the scale. Our work demonstrates that graphs derived from three out of four popular pediatric motor scales can successfully guide humanoid robots to develop these skills. The fourth scale misses some intermediate milestones that the other scales have, which causes some failures. After adding a missing milestone in its graph, it also enables the robot to develop those skills successfully.

papers.title_en: Compositional Humanoid Manipulation through Isomorphic Teleoperation and Independent Skill Routing
papers.authors: Yiming Wang, Peixian Yang, Lifeng Zhuo, Lai Wei, Xinling Du, Kun Song, Weiming Wang, Daolin Ma
papers.evidence: 人形机器人手臂技能组合与运动控制器集成
papers.tldr: 人形机器人操作需要可复用的手臂技能，但逐一演示所有技能组合不现实。作者提出HS-MoDP，用独立语义路由在共享专家池上组合分别演示的手臂技能，并配合语义调度器衔接移动与操作。该设计兼顾手臂专属控制与动作生成参数共享，扩展有效工作空间。基于Unitree G1实验显示技能组合优于基线；同构外骨骼G1Exo提升接触遥操作可靠性，并将柜体流程成功率从35%提至65%。
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid manipulation requires reusable arm skills, yet demonstrating every possible skill combination is impractical. We present Humanoid Semantic Mixture-of-Experts Diffusion Policy (HS-MoDP), which composes separately demonstrated arm skills through independent semantic routing over a shared expert pool. This design preserves arm-specific skill control while sharing action-generation parameters across arms. A semantic scheduler integrates the learned policy with an existing locomotion controller through alternating manipulation and repositioning stages, extending the effective workspace and enabling skill reuse across location changes. To acquire demonstrations of whole-body contact manipulation, we develop G1Exo, an isomorphic exoskeleton that provides direct joint-level control of arm configurations. Experiments on a Unitree G1 show stronger skill composition than the baselines. G1Exo enables more reliable contact teleoperation than end-effector VR-IK, and its demonstrations improve contact-skill learning across four policy architectures. For HS-MoDP, switching from VR-IK to G1Exo demonstrations raises full cabinet workflow success from 35% to 65%. All project hardware designs and source code will be released as open source after the review process.

papers.title_en: Data-Efficient Learning from Demonstration for Humanoid Robots via Feature-Level Perception and Prompt-Based Object Detection
papers.authors: Keyhan Rayati, AliReza Beigy, Anoosheh Saadati, Pourya Shahverdi, Mehdi Tale Masouleh, Ahmad Kalhor, Wing-Yue Geoffrey Louie
papers.evidence: 人形机器人操作技能的示教学习
papers.tldr: 人形机器人从演示中学习技能通常依赖大规模数据和端到端训练，成本高。本文提出数据高效框架，先用分层视觉预处理、Kinect人体关节估计、提示式目标检测和深度信息提取任务特征与物体三维位置，再训练时序模型预测关节轨迹。仿真中仅用16次演示即达78%抓放成功率，100次演示提升至86%。
papers.abstract_en: Learning from Demonstration (LfD) allows robots to learn new skills from human examples; however, many vision-based methods require large datasets and resource-intensive end-to-end training. This paper introduces a data-efficient LfD framework for humanoid robots that learns manipulation skills from compact, task-specific features instead of raw images. The proposed approach integrates layered visual preprocessing, Kinect-based human joint estimation, prompt-based object detection, and depth information to extract human motion features and three-dimensional object locations from demonstration videos. These features are used to train a temporal deep learning model that predicts robot joint-angle trajectories for execution. The framework is implemented on a NAO humanoid robot, evaluated quantitatively in simulation, and demonstrated on physical hardware. In simulation, the robot achieves a 78% success rate on a pick-and-place task using only 16 demonstrations, which increases to 86% when trained with 100 demonstrations. The framework also achieves a 71% success rate on a pushing task using eight demonstrations, highlighting its effectiveness for data-efficient humanoid skill acquisition.

papers.title_en: From Suboptimal to Optimal: One-Step Latent Flow Policies for Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Shenghua Lu, Zixuan Yang, Rongxu Zhao, Bohao Qu, Jifeng Hu, Hechang Chen
papers.evidence: 基于单步潜在流决策块的离线RL策略优化
papers.tldr: 离线强化学习用扩散/流匹配提升策略表达力，但多从无信息高斯噪声出发并需多步迭代，计算昂贵且难利用次优轨迹。MF2B把离线RL重构为高层潜在决策空间中的决策块优化，学习共享条件平均速度场，构建高斯源到正行为区域、次优决策到高价值区域两类流映射，并以Δt=1单步ODE完成精炼。它用分层块级优势引导流向高回报区域，将序列长度从T压缩到K≈T/H。在D4RL Gym-MuJoCo上平均得分90.91，匹配或超过强基线。
papers.abstract_en: Offline reinforcement learning aims to learn effective policies from fixed datasets without environment interaction. Although generative models such as diffusion and flow matching enhance policy expressiveness, they typically start from uninformative Gaussian noise and generate actions through multi-step iteration, leading to high computational costs and failing to effectively leverage suboptimal trajectories in datasets. We propose MeanFlow2Better (MF2B), which reformulates offline RL as generative decision chunk optimization from current performance status to better performance status in a high-level latent decision space. MF2B maps trajectory chunks to high-level latent decision representations through an encoder, placing generation starting points within a structured decision space sculpted by behavioral data. The model learns a shared conditional mean velocity field in this space, constructing two flow mappings: from Gaussian-Induced Decision Sources toward positive behavioral decision regions, and from suboptimal decisions toward high-value decision regions. Both flow mappings complete decision refinement through one-step ODE integration over the unit time interval $Δt=1$, requiring neither multi-step iterative sampling nor backpropagation through time. Furthermore, we propose hierarchical chunk-level advantage to guide the flow direction toward high-return regions, where the high-level decisions cover multiple low-level actions, leading to sequence length compression from $T$ to $K \approx T/H$ and significantly lower computational overhead. On the D4RL Gym-MuJoCo benchmark, MF2B achieves an average score of 90.91, matching or surpassing strong baselines.

papers.title_en: Matching Randomized Bounds for Finite-Sum Nonconvex-Concave Optimization
papers.authors: Wendao Wu, Haihan Zhang, Qian Chen, Chenheng Zhang, Chunyuan Zheng, Cong Fang, Haoxuan Li, Zhouchen Lin
papers.evidence: 有限和非凸-凹极小极大优化的复杂度界
papers.tldr: 本文研究有限和型非凸-凹优化的随机分量预言机复杂度，目标是在固定查询预算下以高概率找到 Moreau 包络的 ε-平稳点。作者结合持久估计、原变量平均与带显式原变量证书的加速近端对偶步骤构造上界，并用锥构造、串行分支构造和平衡复制构造建立匹配下界。所得复杂度在 B≤n^{1/4} 时达到常数意义匹配，在更大 B 时仅差一个对数，且下界覆盖自适应选分量与私有随机化等强情形。
papers.abstract_en: We characterize the randomized component-oracle complexity of finite-sum nonconvex-concave optimization with a bounded dual domain. For $Φ(x)=\max_{y\in Y}n^{-1}\sum_{i=1}^n f_i(x,y)$, the goal is to find an $\varepsilon$-stationary point of the Moreau envelope $Φ_{1/(2L)}$ with probability at least $2/3$ and a fixed query budget. Let $A=LΔ/\varepsilon^2$, $B=LD_Y/\varepsilon$, and $\bar B=\max\{1,B\}$, where $Δ$ bounds the initial primal gap and $D_Y$ bounds the dual diameter. For $A$ above a universal constant, the worst-case complexity is \[ \widetildeΘ\!\left(n+A\min\left\{ \sqrt n\,\bar B+\bar B^4,\ n^{3/4}\bar B\right\}\right). \] The bounds agree within constants for $B\le n^{1/4}$ and within one logarithm for larger $B$. Upper bounds require only mean-squared averaged smoothness and concavity of the average in the dual variable; lower bounds already hold under individual smoothness. The lower constructions cover adaptive component selection, arbitrary query norms, private randomization, and outputs that were never queried. A cone construction gives the small-diameter bound, while a serial branch construction and balanced replication give the remaining two regimes. On the upper side, a persistent estimator with primal averaging complements accelerated proximal dual steps equipped with an explicit primal certificate. The characterization takes the worst case over admissible known dual domains and finite dimensions.

papers.title_en: Theoretical and Computational Advances in Birkhoff Pseudospectral Transcription for Aerospace Optimal Control
papers.authors: Riccardo Minnozzi, Marco Sagliano
papers.evidence: 最优控制问题的伪谱离散与数值求解
papers.tldr: 针对航空航天最优控制，本文扩展Birkhoff伪谱转录的理论与数值方法。推导fLGR网格上的Birkhoff积分算子，并建立控制速率约束下伪谱约束与状态增广的原对偶等价。进一步发展异构多相问题、非仿射时间映射、仿射缩放/均衡组合及混合导数策略，并集成到RAPTOR框架。多类基准验证了方法在着陆、轨道提升、再入与可重复使用运载器多相轨迹中的有效性。
papers.abstract_en: This paper develops theoretical and numerical extensions of Birkhoff pseudospectral transcription for aerospace optimal control problems. Building on the recently proposed body of knowledge, a Birkhoff integration operator is derived for flipped Legendre Gauss Radau (fLGR) grids, drawing connections to regular LGR grids and to the favorable conditioning properties that make Birkhoff interpolants particularly appealing. We also propose the enforcement of differential constraints via pseudospectral operators, and the primal and dual equivalence of this approach to state augmentation is established for control-rate limits. The numerical developments include the formulation and solution of heterogeneous multiphase optimal control problems, parameterized non-affine time mappings, composition of affine scaling and equilibration methods, and a hybrid derivative strategy to combine linear pseudospectral operators with numerical derivatives for nonlinear functions. These methods are implemented in the RAPTOR (Rapid Algorithm for Pseudospectral Trajectory Optimization and Robustification) transcription framework and assessed through feature-oriented benchmarks: a one-dimensional landing problem, a planar orbit-raising scenario, an atmospheric entry problem, and a multiphase reusable launch vehicle problem with simultaneous booster-recovery and upper-stage-insertion trajectories.

papers.title_en: Robust Counterfactuals for Markov Decision Processes under Statistical and Causal Uncertainties
papers.authors: Jessica Lally, Milad Kazemi, Nicola Paoletti
papers.evidence: MDP不确定性下的反事实推断
papers.tldr: 在由轨迹数据估计的MDP中，反事实推断同时受转移统计不确定性与未知因果模型不确定性影响，现有方法多分别处理。本文提出对二者均稳健的部分反事实推断框架，基于区间MDP给出跨所有相容SCM均成立的反事实概率闭式解析界。进一步在诱导的反事实IMDP上做悲观值迭代，求取实现目标反事实结果的最小稳健干预。实验表明该方法可高效识别若改变即可改善结果的最小动作集合。
papers.abstract_en: Counterfactual reasoning (asking what would have happened, had a decision been different) is a powerful tool for identifying causes of failure and explaining the behaviour of AI systems in sequential decision-making tasks. In Markov Decision Processes (MDPs), two sources of uncertainty complicate counterfactual inference: statistical uncertainty in the MDP transitions when the MDP is estimated from trajectory data, and uncertainty about the unknown causal model, as there are multiple structural causal models (SCMs) compatible with each MDP. Existing work addresses these two challenges in isolation. We address both simultaneously by introducing a framework for partial counterfactual inference in MDPs that is robust to both statistical and causal uncertainty. Our approach provides: 1) closed-form analytical bounds for the counterfactual probabilities that are valid across all SCMs entailed by a given interval MDP (IMDP); 2) a method to compute minimal robust interventions to achieve a desired counterfactual outcome via pessimistic value iteration on the induced counterfactual IMDP. Since the latter is constructed using our analytical bounds, our approach remains efficient and scalable to realistic MDP environments. Experiments across multiple case studies demonstrate our method's robustness and practical utility for identifying minimal sets of actions that, if changed, would have led to improved outcomes.

papers.title_en: Efficient Test-Time Adaptation For Robot Policies
papers.authors: Motasem Alfarra, Pietro Mazzaglia, Markus Peschl, Daniel Dijkman, Christos Louizos
papers.evidence: 机器人运动强化学习策略自适应
papers.tldr: 机器人强化学习控制策略在部署时遇到地形、负载或传感变化容易失效，重训与人工校准又受端侧时延和内存限制。作者研究无奖励、自监督的测试时适应，以冻结预训练critic作为部署性能代理，仅更新actor，并提出TEMPO：用熵正则缓解critic过度自信外推，再用基于分数的优先记忆聚焦低价值困难样本。在Go1、Go2、G1多种偏移和架构下取得一致提升，单设备最高提升80%，并在负载Go2真机上验证端侧适应有效。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement-learning policies for robot locomotion can fail at deployment when operating conditions shift (e.g., rough or slippery terrain, payload changes, sensing degradation), and retraining or manual recalibration is often infeasible under on-device latency and memory constraints. We study test-time adaptation (TTA) for robotic control: adapting a pretrained policy online and in a self-supervised manner during execution, without access to rewards. Our starting point is a lightweight baseline that updates only the actor using a frozen pretrained critic as a deployment-time performance surrogate. Building on this, we introduce TEMPO, a test-time entropy-regularized, memory-guided policy optimization method that stabilizes critic-driven updates under severe shift. TEMPO combines (i) an entropy-promoting regularizer on the critic's predictive distribution to mitigate overconfident extrapolation, and (ii) a score-based memory, inspired by prioritized replay, that prioritizes low-value ("hard") observations and applies importance sampling to focus limited computation on the most informative deployment conditions. Across Go1, Go2, and G1 in MuJoCo Playground under four representative shifts and multiple architectures, TEMPO yields consistent gains, reaching up to 80% improvement in a single-device setting. We further validate on a physical Unitree Go2 with an added calf payload, where fully on-device adaptation improves performance over the non-adapted baseline across real-world episodes.

papers.title_en: Modeling and Understanding Neural Weights of Humanoid Policies with Diffusion
papers.authors: Huixuan Cheng, Bike Zhang, Shankar Sastry, Koushil Sreenath
papers.evidence: 用潜在扩散生成式建模人形控制网络权重
papers.tldr: 人形控制网络通常依赖常规训练获得，其学习到的权重分布本身很少被直接建模和生成。本文提出潜扩散框架，用线性自编码器将actor网络参数压缩到紧凑潜空间，再由Diffusion Transformer学习该潜变量分布。基于Unitree G1的强化学习网络集训练后，方法能生成可部署网络，并在真实世界完成行走、跳舞和回旋踢等动作。研究进一步分析权重空间，发现首层权重稳定反映机器人运动学先验，且该先验在RL与IL训练中均出现，为理解人形具身策略的权重结构提供初步证据。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in robot learning have driven rapid progress in humanoid control, enabling increasingly agile behaviors in the real world. However, humanoid control networks are typically obtained through conventional training procedures, while comparatively little attention has been given to directly modeling the distribution of their learned weights and generating functional networks in weight space. In this work, we investigate whether high-performing humanoid control networks can be generatively modeled directly through their weights. We adopt a latent diffusion framework that couples a linear autoencoder with a Diffusion Transformer. The autoencoder compresses actor network parameters into a compact latent space, and the Diffusion Transformer models the distribution of these latents. Trained on networks collected from reinforcement learning for the Unitree G1 robot, our approach generates deployable networks that perform various motions in the real world, including walking, dancing, and spin kick. Beyond generation, we further study the learned weight space to better understand the structure captured by these humanoid control networks. We identify a structural principle in the first-layer weights that consistently reflects the robot's kinematic prior. Notably, this kinematic prior emerges under both Reinforcement Learning (RL) and Imitation Learning (IL) training, suggesting that it is not specific to a particular optimization process but may instead reflect common knowledge associated with humanoid embodiment. Together, these results demonstrate the feasibility of generative modeling in humanoid network weight space, while providing initial insights into the information encoded by their learned weights. Additional results are available on our project website: https://humanoid-weight-diffusion.github.io/

papers.title_en: SOMA: Stack-of-Objects Manipulation using a Quadruped Robot
papers.authors: Stergios E. Bachoumas, Panagiotis Artemiadis
papers.evidence: 面向足式机器人全身控制的层次强化学习
papers.tldr: 四足机器人缺乏专用机械臂，在非结构化环境中推动重物与多层堆叠物体仍很困难。SOMA采用分层强化学习，将高层操作策略与底层运动策略解耦，并用S5编码长时历史、通过Beta分布输出受限目标指令。仿真中单物体重定位成功率90.3%，双箱堆叠最高90.1%，满足0.05米与1度误差。真机零样本迁移验证了主动调高机身以维持牵引和平衡。
papers.abstract_en: Executing heavy-duty physical manipulation in unpredictable environments remains a major challenge for quadrupedal robots lacking dedicated manipulators. This paper presents SOMA, a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework for whole-body non-prehensile manipulation of multi-object stacks using a quadruped robot. Unlike traditional methods restricted to two-dimensional planar pushing, SOMA integrates explicit robot base-height control, unlocking full three-dimensional pushing strategies. This capability enables the quadruped to manipulate complex payload stacks as a unified system while preventing relative sliding or tipping of upper layers. The architecture factorizes control into a high-level manipulation policy using a Simplified Structured State Space Sequence (S5) encoder to reason over long-horizon temporal history and predict bounded target tracking commands via Beta distributions, and a low-level locomotion policy that dynamically adapts leg stance configurations. In extensive simulation benchmarks, SOMA achieves a $90.3\%$ success rate for single-object reposing and up to $90.1\%$ for dynamic two-box stacks under stringent error margins ($0.05\text{ m}$ position error, $1^\circ$ orientation error). Finally, we validate zero-shot sim-to-real transfer on a Unitree Go1 quadruped robot across diverse payload masses and geometries, demonstrating active base-height adjustments to maintain traction and balance during heavy pushing tasks.
